outline: 物流有隱含供應鏈的觀念，物流管理係從供應商、製造商到最終顧客，整個配銷通路管理的整合性哲學。內容有物流構面、供應鏈、存貨決定、倉儲管理、運輸管理、訂單處理、資訊系統、全球物流等。
schedule:
Week 1-2: Supply Chain Management Overview
Week 3-4: The Evolution of Supply Chain Management
Week 5-6: Major Functions in Supply Chain Management
Week 7-8: Major Challenges in Supply Chain Management
Week 9-10: Role of Logistic Management
Week 11-12: Inventory Management and Network Planning
Week 13-14: Supply Chain Technology – The value of information
Week 15-16: Information Technology and Business Processes
Week 17-18: Supply Chain Integration and Performance Measurements
assessment:
Midterm Exam 30%
Final Project 30%
Homework and Casework 20%
Class Participation – (Think and Discuss) 20%
